scenario_description:
Objective: Keep Mina’s planned overnight childcare coverage workable during Cedar Walk visitor-parking enforcement.
Emerging Need: The stay has not begun, but her car will need an approved temporary permit before the HOA’s same-day cutoff.
Decision Context: The observable updates establish Gideon’s absence, Mina’s driving plan, the current-dues condition, and the permit deadline; the stored HOA note supplies the resident account, permit route, vehicle plate, and no-paid-parking preference.
Consequence: Before approvals close, the missing prerequisite can still preserve the parking arrangement; afterward, the same details no longer prevent an unpermitted overnight vehicle.

parameter.subject: Sealcoating schedule for Cedar Walk visitor spaces
parameter.body: Cary Oaks HOA will sealcoat Cedar Walk visitor spaces Friday evening through Sunday. Overnight guest parking may be limited; the board will send final permit rules after contractor staging is confirmed. Resident decals are unaffected.

parameter.title: All-district music clinic - Raleigh
parameter.description: Workshop day; arrange coverage for Leo and Anya.

parameter.content: I can stay over at your place Friday night and keep the kids until you get back from the Saturday clinic. I’ll bring my own car and leave it in the visitor row unless you tell me otherwise.

parameter.description: Monthly townhome association dues cleared before sealcoating weekend.

parameter.subject: Final temporary parking rules for sealcoating weekend
parameter.body: Final parking rules for Cedar Walk sealcoating: any non-resident vehicle remaining overnight in the visitor row Friday Oct 30 or Saturday Oct 31 must have a temporary overnight permit approved before 4:00 PM today, Thursday Oct 29. Requests need the resident account number and vehicle plate. Permits are issued only for accounts current on dues; no after-hours approvals will be processed.

parameter.subject: Temporary permit approvals closed for sealcoating weekend
parameter.body: The temporary overnight permit queue for Cedar Walk sealcoating has closed. Staff will not process new requests before Friday enforcement; visitor vehicles without an approved permit should not remain overnight in the affected row.
